intent: Select the common variants of panel_sites.vcf.gz: keep a site only if its minor allele frequency (from INFO AC and AN) is at least 5%.
silent_error: bcftools view -q/--min-af measures the frequency of the non-reference allele by default (usage text: '-q/Q, --min-af/--max-af FLOAT[:TYPE]  Minimum/maximum frequency for non-reference (nref), 1st alternate (alt1), least frequent (minor), most frequent (major) or sum of all but most frequent (nonmajor) alleles [nref]'). -q 0.05 is therefore 'ALT frequency >= 5%', not 'MAF >= 5%': rs1476413 (ALT 98%, MAF 2%) and rs4846048 (ALT 100%, monomorphic for ALT) pass although the reference allele is the rare one.
